items.passageEn: Mr. Huang has observed birds for twenty years. He first became interested in birds when he was a boy. Last year, he settled in a small village near the mountains, where many rare birds live. He now gives talks to promote the protection of these birds. People have started to associate the village with bird watching, and there is a growing demand for local guides. Mr. Huang hopes young people will lift their eyes from their phones and enjoy nature.
items.passageZh: 黃先生觀察鳥類已經二十年了。他小時候就開始對鳥產生興趣。去年，他在山區附近的一個小村子定居，那裡住著許多稀有的鳥。他現在會去演講，推廣保護這些鳥類。人們開始把這個村子和賞鳥聯想在一起，對當地導覽員的需求也越來越大。黃先生希望年輕人能把眼睛從手機上抬起來，好好欣賞大自然。

options: 自己開了一家小旅行社
在山區附近的村子定居
寫了一本和鳥有關的書

questions.questionZh: 黃先生演講是為了什麼？

items.promptZh: 他們終於解決了這場爭執。
referenceEn: At last, they settled their argument.
rubricZh: settle 表示「解決」，後面接爭執、問題等（例如 settle the argument）
過去的事用過去式（例如 settled）

items.promptZh: 老闆要求我們在明天早上以前完成報告。
referenceEn: The boss demanded that we finish the report by tomorrow morning.
Our boss demanded that we finish the report before tomorrow morning.
rubricZh: 用 demand 表示「要求」（例如 demanded that we finish…；寫 asked us to finish 也正確）
時態可用 demands、demanded 等；that 子句動詞用原形或 should＋原形都可以（例如 finish、should finish）
